chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhl from Ali ibn Asbat from Muhammad ibn Humran from Zurara from one of them (peace be upon him) in
the one who is divorced in a state of purity in one session three times, he said: She is one (divorce).
ai.seo_question: How many divorces count if a husband says 'you are divorced' three times in one sitting during his wife's purity period?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies the jurisprudential debate regarding whether multiple divorce pronouncements in a single session constitute one or three divorces, with the Imam ruling that they count as a single revocable divorce (talaq wahid). This ruling is significant in Shia fiqh as it prevents the immediate irrevocability of divorce, allowing for reconciliation within the waiting period (iddah). The chain of narration through Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Humran highlights the transmission of this legal principle from the Imams to the early jurists.
